one_liner: Help desk software with ticketing, live chat, and knowledge base

evidence.claim: API v3 authenticates via an API key sent in the request header
evidence.quote: Your API key has to be set in header of your requests:

evidence.claim: API keys are self-serve: admin generates them under Configuration > System > API, with per-key permissions
evidence.quote: While logged in as an admin navigate to Configuration> System> API which loads the API v3 section where you find existing API keys or add a new one.

evidence.claim: A free 30-day trial is available and API access is included in all subscriptions, so credentials are obtainable without payment
evidence.quote: API and integrations are included in each subscription without any additional costs. A 30-day free trial is available for all subscriptions.

evidence.claim: REST API has two versions; v3 is actively developed and v1 is deprecated, covering many resources (tickets, conversations, customers, companies, reports, tags, knowledgebase)
evidence.quote: API v3 – The current, actively developed version. New endpoints and enhancements are continuously added.

evidence.claim: LiveAgent provides an official built-in MCP server supporting Bearer token and OAuth 2.1 (Authorization Code + PKCE)
evidence.quote: LiveAgent exposes a built-in MCP server (Model Context Protocol) that lets you connect external AI tools

notes: API v1 and v3 require separate keys; using the wrong key yields 403 'ApiKey not found'. v3 docs (https://YOURDOMAIN.ladesk.com/docs/api/v3/#/) and Swagger/OpenAPI descriptor live inside the account, but a free trial unlocks them. Number of API keys scales by plan (1/5/10/100). Official MCP server at https://<domain>/api/mcp over Streamable HTTP with a documented tool set (read tickets, notes, fields; transfer, etc.). Regenerating a key instantly invalidates old clients.
